'''Roksur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] hired by [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] to retrieve a piece of [[Nok Drayen]]'s wealth from [[Zone Zero]] in [[Transport Station 5]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Roksur and his gang made it to the vault with great effort, but were apprehended by the future [[Voidhound]] and [[Corso Riggs]]. After a short holocall to Skavak, they were ordered to attack, but were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the ensuing shoot-out.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
